name: Student Performance Visualization
description: CSV-driven academic analytics with dynamic subject detection, rankings, performance bands, and charts.
summary: An uploaded student table is transformed into totals, averages, rankings, and descriptive classroom insights. The dashboard analyzes recorded marks rather than predicting future performance.
architecture: A Streamlit application reads uploaded CSV records into Pandas, detects the student identifier and numeric subject columns, and computes per-student totals, averages, and performance categories. Dedicated dashboard views expose class statistics, ranked records, category filtering, Matplotlib charts, and processed CSV downloads.

capabilities.name: Dynamic dataset processing
capabilities.description: Detect student and numeric subject columns and derive total and average marks.

capabilities.name: Rankings and performance bands
capabilities.description: Rank students by total marks and filter rule-based performance categories.

capabilities.name: Classroom visualizations
capabilities.description: Compare student totals and subject averages through descriptive charts.

capabilities.name: Processed CSV download
capabilities.description: Download the student dataset with calculated performance fields.

stack.usage: Organizes dataset processing and reusable dashboard rendering functions.
Provides CSV uploads, navigation, category selection, data tables, chart panels, and downloads.
Detects numeric columns, computes totals and averages, sorts rankings, filters categories, and serializes CSV output.
Creates bar charts for student total marks and subject-wise average marks rendered by Streamlit.

architectureConnections.description: Derived student and subject statistics supply the chart data.
Uploaded CSV data drives tables, rankings, and downloadable results.

evidence.notes: Reviewed implementation files and repository structure during the repository audit. Only implemented behavior is recorded; availability does not imply production readiness.
